description_zh: 自动驾驶车辆在常规模式下试图绕过双排停放的车辆时，右侧方擦碰到该静止车辆。

source_snippets: An Apollo autonomous vehicle (“AV”) was traveling westbound on Rivera Street in San Francisco in autonomous mode and stopped for a double-parked vehicle near 31st Avenue. An Apollo safety operator disengaged the AV from autonomous mode into conventional mode with use of the steering wheel. Then the AV side-swiped the double-parked vehicle while in conventional mode.
evidence.reason: Ego进入对向车道以绕过静止的双排停放车辆，擦碰发生。NPC为静止的vehicle，位置相邻右侧。
